online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

for dusklight 2.0.3. everyone has to update: it only connects to 1.8.4.

this build:
- fixed tears of light softlock
- fixed a forest temple crash
- fixed multiple hero's shades spawning in hidden skills
- villagers use your own name
- fixed rando progressive items
- fixed holding a sword you don't own after joining
- encrypted room codes
- better bug reports
- added hyrule online
- added global chat
- added blocking
- fixed missing swords on players
- less data for epona
- hyrule online tab, network tab is optional
